text:
lee_k: Heads up — nightly retrieval eval failed for cohort B. recall@10 down ~18% vs baseline.

maria_g: saw that. looks correlated with reranker v2-quant (released 04:30). metrics attached in eval job.

alex_r: can you paste the top failing sample ids?

lee_k: eval-bot posted them:

eval-bot: ALERT: nightly-evals/20260305 cohort=B recall@10: baseline=0.64 new=0.52 (-0.12)

lee_k: sample query: "how to revoke api key" topk ids baseline [1234,5678,9012] new [1234,0000,9012]

chris_p: 0000 looks like an empty vector placeholder — maybe prefill failed after quantization.

devon: ran local reproduce: 
```
python -m eval.run --cohort B --reranker v2-quant --seed 42 --dump-neighbors 5
```
got same pattern, several neighbor ids are 0 or repeated.

maria_g: digging into indexer logs around deploy time: ops-bot shows a scaling event at 04:29 that coincides.

ops-bot: deploy: reranker/v2-quant promoted to prod at 2026-03-05T04:30:12Z. autoscaler scaled indexer pool from 3->1 at 04:28:58Z due to bug.

alex_r: scaling indexer to 1 likely caused partial shard fetch returning empty vectors — reranker saw zeros and misranked.

lee_k: mitigation: rollback reranker to v2-fp16 and bump indexer replicas back to 3. can we do quick canary?

devon: started rollback PR: #4512. staging canary at 04:50. instructing eval pipeline to re-run.

maria_g: re-run started. if recall recovers, we still need postmortem: add indexer autoscale guard and reranker pre-check for zero vectors.

chris_p: I'll add a cheap pre-check: reject request if >5% neighbors are zero vectors, return fallback.

lee_k: thanks. also save all failing queries + neighbor dumps to s3://redwood-evals/triage/1767623345 for deeper analysis.

eval-bot: JOB: nightly-evals rerun queued (job id ny-1767623345-repro).

alex_r: assign to eng-ml/infra and eng-ml/retrieval for postmortem. pinging oncall.

lee_k: @maria_g @chris_p @devon please coordinate. will follow up in postmortem thread.

maria_g: ack :thumbsup:
